· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid $518.38): trading near the middle band, 13.40% band width showing slowing expansion.

· Swing resistance ($500.76): based on 5-day high and pivot, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): maintaining wait-and-see conditions due to lack of direction.
